summary: Frontend regression for the two just-shipped MOD features: (A) Master Admin inline Location editor in the MOD estate kit-drill modal and (B) MOD Fault Wizard grouping equipment by those locations. Both flows verified GREEN, including a full end-to-end consistency check (edit location in Master Admin → new group appears live in the Fault Wizard → restore returns machine to Unassigned).

steps: Clicked kit-by-category chip on MOD Test Site card (mod-equip-kit-cat-<siteId>-strength)
mod-kit-drill-modal opened with mod-kit-drill-table (3 Strength rows: Fusion DAP=Cardio Suite, Functional Trainer=<empty>, Leg Press=Main Gym)
Edited mod-kit-location-input-c4fa1a00-... (Functional Trainer) to 'Free Weights Zone TEST' + Enter
Closed and re-opened kit drill → input value still 'Free Weights Zone TEST' (persistence OK)
Hint (mod-kit-location-hint) present with expected copy about Fault Wizard grouping
Impersonated MOD Test Site via POST /api/master-admin/org-portal-login/<siteId>
Stored returned token in localStorage and opened /pulse
Clicked Faults tab → log-fault-btn → wizard opened at mod-step-equipment
Verified groups rendered: mod-equipment-group-cardio-suite (3), mod-equipment-group-main-gym (4), mod-equipment-group-free-weights-zone-test (1 = Functional Trainer PF-MODTS-008)
Confirmed target equipment card mod-equipment-c4fa1a00-... sits under mod-equipment-group-free-weights-zone-test (live consistency with Master Admin edit)
Reloaded /pulse and re-opened wizard → groups now: cardio-suite (3), main-gym (4), unassigned (1). free-weights-zone-test group removed. Restored state matches original demo layout.

critical_code_review_comments: MODSiteOnboarding.js: input uses defaultValue + onBlur/Enter; works, but if the API PATCH fails the UI silently keeps the typed value because saveEquipLocation optimistically updates on success only via a re-set. Consider reverting the input to the old value on error (currently only a notify.error is shown). Low priority.

StepEquipment.jsx: group data-testid slug uses .replace(/\s+/g,'-').toLowerCase() which is fine for 'Main Gym'→'main-gym', 'Free Weights Zone TEST'→'free-weights-zone-test' etc., but non-ASCII/punctuation zones (e.g. 'Level 2 — Cardio') would collapse to dashes-with-hyphens and could collide. Consider a stricter slugify for future.
Equipment PATCH endpoint returns location:null when clearing — frontend correctly treats null as Unassigned in the wizard grouping (loc || 'Unassigned'). Good.
